seo.description: See Borj Al-Kamra in Asilah: the Portuguese square tower by the main medina gate, a compact landmark of the Atlantic art town.

name: Borj Al-Kamra
hero_subtitle: A Portuguese square tower standing by the main gate of Asilah’s medina — a compact historic landmark.

overview.title: A Portuguese marker at the gate
overview.p1: Borj Al-Kamra is the square Portuguese tower near Asilah’s main medina entrance. It is a quick but iconic stop when you enter or leave the white alleys.
overview.p2: Photograph it with the surrounding walls and gate, then continue into the art medina or out toward the ramparts.
overview.p3: It pairs naturally with a 90-minute medina loop.
